faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ERNET India Administrative Assistant (Procurement) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the ERNET India Administrative Assistant (Procurement) recruitment is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates should be a Graduate in any discipline with 04 years of post-qualification experience in procurement, or a Post-graduate in any discipline with 02 years of post-qualification experience in procurement in government departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Administrative Assistant (Procurement) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Administrative Assistant (Procurement) post is 35 years. Specific age relaxation rules may apply as per government guidelines, which can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Administrative Assistant (Procurement) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 35,000/- to Rs. 50,000/- per month, depending on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the ERNET India Administrative Assistant (Procurement) job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to forward their application and CV/bio-data, along with self-attested copies of certificates, to the specified email address: [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Administrative Assistant (Procurement) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Administrative Assistant (Procurement) role will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. What kind of experience is required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have hands-on experience in GeM procurement and all types of bidding at the GeM portal. Working knowledge of e-files, noting, and drafting of letters, O.M, P.O & work order is also required.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Administrative Assistant (Procurement) at ERNET India is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is ERNET India located?
faq.answer: ERNET India is located in Delhi, with the pincode 110053.
